title: Shreyas Iyer's Maiden Century Powers India to Cakewalk Victory in First T20I
indian_angle: Indian skipper Shreyas Iyer scored a maiden T20I century leading India to a dominant victory against West Indies.
summary: Skipper Shreyas Iyer's maiden T20I century powered India to a comfortable win against West Indies in the first T20I, securing victory with 32 balls to spare.

title: Fenesta Open: Sureshkumar-Sinha Advance to Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Top-seeded Indian pair Manish Sureshkumar and Nitin Sinha progressed to the quarterfinals of the domestic Fenesta Open.
summary: Top seeds Manish Sureshkumar and Nitin Sinha secured their spot in the Fenesta Open quarterfinals with a 7-5, 6-2 victory over Raghav Jaisinghani and Lakshit Sood.

title: India's Fight Fades as Uruguay Nets Six in Football Friendly
indian_angle: The Indian football team suffered a heavy defeat against Uruguay, conceding six goals despite an early equalizer from Thapa.
summary: India's defensive discipline faltered in the second half as Uruguay scored six goals in a football friendly, overshadowing an early equalizer by Thapa.

title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar Returns to India T20I Squad After Four-Year Gap

summary: Pacer Bhuvneshwar Kumar makes a comeback to the Indian T20I squad for the New Zealand series, marking his return to international cricket after a four-year gap.

title: Smriti Mandhana Appointed Indian Women’s Cricket Team Captain

summary: Smriti Mandhana takes over as the captain of the Indian women's cricket team following Harmanpreet Kaur's decision to step down from the leadership role.

title: India Expresses Interest to Host 2036 Olympics
indian_angle: India is among seven countries that have expressed interest to the IOC in hosting the 2036 Olympic Games.
summary: India, along with six other nations, has formally expressed interest to the International Olympic Committee in hosting the 2036 Olympic Games, with project presentations due in November.
